as_of_note: Compiled 2026-11-11 by the Oman source-audit lane (iteration 19, Wave A). A DRAFT in the local candidate queue. CONTEXT ONLY: never a scoring input. Every value was read from the cited document in this session; vintages differ (2024 and 2025) and are stated per row, and 2025 statistical values are marked provisional by their publisher. Bases differ by source (country totals from the National Centre for Statistics and Information, which credits the Ministry of Energy and Minerals and the Authority for Public Services Regulation; power-system figures from Nama Power and Water Procurement; a company total from Oman LNG) and are labelled on each row. Refining capacity and generating capacity were NOT read this session and are absent, not zero. National totals from the U.S. EIA are served by the global context layer and are not repeated here. No facility rows. See docs/countries/OM_SOURCE_AUDIT.md.

significance: Oman produced an average of about 1.0 million barrels of oil per day in 2025 and exported about 308 million barrels in the year, equivalent to about 84% of production (National Centre for Statistics and Information, crediting the Ministry of Energy and Minerals; share computed).
Power generation used about 27% of Oman's gas supply in 2025 (National Centre for Statistics and Information; share computed from 15,494 of 57,056 million cubic metres).
Solar and wind projects supplied around 9% of electricity production in 2025, against a stated target of 30% by 2030 (Nama Power and Water Procurement).
Oman LNG reported LNG production of 11.98 million tonnes in 2024.
Oman has no coal production and no coal-fired generation (U.S. EIA International Energy Statistics, 2024, as committed in this repository's global context layer).
